svg.title: EEG Emotion Recognition
svg.desc: EEG Emotion Recognition. Experimental BSc thesis in Biomedical Engineering at the Research Center E. Piaggio: emotion recognition from EEG signals of 35 subjects viewing IAPS images, with MATLAB and EEGLAB preprocessing, band-power features and a KNN classifier.
svg.text: Recognising emotions from brain signals. EEG from 35 subjects
viewing 72 IAPS images, cleaned in MATLAB and EEGLAB; band-power
features feed a KNN classifier that tells positive, neutral and
MATLAB | EEGLAB | Signal processing | Machine learning
